scope: Fresh frontier enrichment of the shortest remaining unaudited/under-detailed canonical mechanics records after Batch 484.

selected.findings: Current dedicated evidence confirms 100-Ki Other Super, Pan training acquisition, hypnosis/forced dance, Evasive escape, and rapid Stamina recovery while dancing.
Current dedicated evidence confirms 100-Ki Strike Super from PQ105; no direct damage; rapidly drains enemy Stamina; holding too long exhausts the user and creates about one second of vulnerability.

Current evidence confirms 400-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate from PQ132, rush/opening pair, 25-ball barrage plus final projectile, re-input release, teleport behind opponent if hit during approach, and distinct Festival variant.

Current dedicated/Awoken evidence reconfirms 500-Ki Saiyan-only restriction, level 95+/Vegeta friendship/prior SSGSS prerequisites, +35% attack, +10% damage reduction, and 18-Ki-per-second drain presentation.
Current evidence identifies a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from PQ139 with ascent Super Armor and a single Ki-ball hit documented at about 10% damage.

Current evidence confirms 300-Ki one-stage Saiyan Awoken, Future Gohan mission after five Time Distorted Eggs, +10% Basic/+5% Basic Ki Blast/+5% Ki Skill/+10% Strike, no damage reduction, and increased Stamina/movement speeds.

Current evidence confirms 500+ Ki Strike Ultimate, TP Medal Shop acquisition, rush/multi-hit sequence, remaining-Ki-scaled energy sphere, chase-on-dodge behavior, and 500 TP Medal price in current dedicated documentation.
Current evidence confirms 200-Stamina Power Up Evasive, close-range shockwave, about 2% damage, about 1.5% Basic Attack increase for about 12 seconds, and Skill Shop acquisition.

sources_policy: Current Xenoverse 2-specific skill evidence was prioritized. Source-reported numerical values remain explicitly bounded; no unsupported frames, probabilities, hidden conditions, or fixed shop schedules were inferred.
canonical_sync: Eight records synchronized in docs/data/skills.json and docs/data/skills-index.json.
